title: Split Repo Binary Entry Points
description: Refactor repo/cli/main.go into repo/client/main.go for shared client code, repo/cli/main.go for Cobra CLI code, and repo/mcp/main.go for MCP code. Keep existing behavior working and update existing tests only as needed.
summary: Refactored the repo binary entry points into repo/client, repo/cli, and repo/mcp. The shared implementation lives in repo/client with exported CLI and MCP runners; repo/cli/main.go and repo/mcp/main.go are thin process entry points. Repo workspace modules include client/cli/mcp, and MCP configuration files point directly at go run ./repo/mcp. Verification: go test ./client ./cli ./mcp ./go ./server -run TestDoesNotExist passed; go run ./cli --help passed; focused client tests for configure/CLI ticket lifecycle/MCP tool registration passed. Full go test ./client still times out/fails on pre-existing unrelated tests: TestNativeBootstrapAssetsStayRepoRelative compose/coda expectations, TestCollectGoTestsInSection, TestFixtureBreachsByLanguage, and TestGraphQLAnalyzeQuery timeout.
